class.name: MaszynaLinesGeometry
class.brief_description: The [code]lines[/code] nodes of one section of the 1 km grid, merged and made into a mesh.
class.description: The scenery's [code]lines[/code], [code]line_strip[/code] and [code]line_loop[/code] nodes - the wires of power lines, mostly - of one section, merged as the original merges them in its 250 m cells ([code]basic_cell::insert()[/code], scene.cpp:302-326) and made into the mesh [code]scenery_lines.gdshader[/code] draws: a line a few pixels wide fading with the distance of its node's centre, as [code]opengl33renderer.cpp[/code] draws them. Filled by [code]SceneryLines[/code] from a scenery's nodes and by [MaszynaLegacySBTTerrainProvider] from a region file.

method.name: add_lines
method.description: Adds a node's lines, pairs of points in the world (an odd last one is left out); [param range_max] 0 is no limit. The node is merged into one of its cell with the same ranges, colour and width whose centre is closer than 10 m, as the original does.

method.name: build_mesh
method.description: A quad per line, relative to [member origin]: the vertex one end, CUSTOM0 the other end and the side, CUSTOM1 the node's centre and radius, CUSTOM2 its width, range_min and range_max, COLOR its colour. No material.

method.name: get_range_end
method.description: How far from the centre of the mesh's box the camera sees a line of it; 0 when one has no limit.

method.name: position_get_section_origin
method.description: The centre of the section of the 1 km grid holding [param position] - the origin of the geometry of the lines whose centre is there.

members.member: The section's centre, which the mesh is relative to.

constants.constant: The vertices of a line's quad.
The indices of a line's two triangles.
